The Destination

Nosy Be

Located just off the north-west coast of Madagascar, Nosy Be is the country’s most popular island destination, known for its warm climate, fragrant ylang-ylang plantations and stunning beaches. Often referred to as the “Perfume Island,” Nosy Be offers a perfect balance of tropical relaxation, vibrant culture and adventure, making it an ideal gateway to explore the surrounding archipelago.

With its palm-fringed shores, turquoise waters and spectacular sunsets, Nosy Be is a year-round destination that appeals to honeymooners, families and adventure seekers alike.

Natural Beauty

Nature & Wildlife

Nosy Be is characterised by rolling hills, volcanic lakes and lush vegetation. The island’s interior is dotted with plantations producing vanilla, coffee, cocoa and spices, adding to its rich sensory appeal. Along the coast, visitors will find a mix of lively beachfront areas and quieter, more secluded bays.

Just offshore, a collection of smaller islands — including Nosy Komba and Nosy Tanikely — offer exceptional opportunities for day trips and marine exploration.

Experiences

Things to Do in Nosy Be

Snorkelling & Diving

Nosy Be is one of Madagascar’s top marine destinations. The surrounding reefs are teeming with colourful fish, coral gardens, sea turtles and seasonal marine life such as manta rays and whale sharks. Nearby marine reserves provide protected environments ideal for both snorkelling and diving.

Island Hopping

Explore the neighbouring islands by boat, each offering something unique — from forest-covered landscapes and lemur encounters to pristine, uninhabited beaches and crystal-clear waters.

Whale & Dolphin Watching

From July to September, humpback whales migrate through the channel, offering unforgettable sightings. Dolphins can be spotted year-round on ocean excursions.

Cultural & Market Visits

Visit local markets and villages to experience Malagasy culture firsthand. Discover traditional crafts, fresh produce and the rhythms of island life.

Ylang-Ylang & Spice Plantation Tours

Learn about the island’s nickname with guided visits to plantations producing essential oils and spices, offering insight into local agriculture and heritage.

Sunset Views from Mont Passot

Take in panoramic views of the island’s crater lakes and coastline from Mont Passot — one of the best spots for sunset on the island.

Where to Stay

Accommodation in Nosy Be

Nosy Be offers a diverse range of accommodation options to suit different travel styles, from relaxed beachfront retreats to more refined boutique properties. Many properties are set along the island’s west coast, providing easy access to beaches, restaurants and activities.

Comfortable rooms and suites with ocean or garden views
Direct beach access and swimming pools set within tropical gardens
On-site restaurants serving fresh seafood and Malagasy and international cuisine
Wellness facilities including spas, massage treatments and relaxation areas
Easy access to excursions, water sports and island tours
Some of the island’s well-established properties combine convenience with a welcoming atmosphere, offering comfort, leisure facilities and proximity to local attractions.

As part of a tailored itinerary with The Madagascar Collection, Nosy Be can be seamlessly combined with more remote and exclusive destinations, creating a journey that showcases the very best of north-west Madagascar.

When to Visit

May – October
Dry season. Best conditions for diving, wildlife watching and island exploration.
July – September
Humpback whale migration season — unmissable.
October – December
Whale shark season in the surrounding waters.
Year-Round
Nosy Be’s warm climate makes it a destination for every month.
